parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. Not required if authenticating with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: fromPatchSetBizId
parameters.description:
The business ID of the patch set for the merge target.

> In APIs related to merge requests and comparisons, `from` and `to` may seem counterintuitive. `from` specifies the merge target, and `to` specifies the merge source. This order aligns with the execution sequence of a native Git command. The source and target labels in the UI are adjusted for clarity.

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The local ID of the merge request within its repository.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. Find this ID in the URL of Alibaba Cloud DevOps: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/<organizationId>`.

parameters.name: repositoryIdentity
parameters.description: The ID or full path of the repository.

parameters.name: toPatchSetBizId
parameters.description:
The business ID of the patch set for the merge source.

> In APIs related to merge requests and comparisons, `from` and `to` may seem counterintuitive. `from` specifies the merge target, and `to` specifies the merge source. This order aligns with the execution sequence of a native Git command. The source and target labels in the UI are adjusted for clarity.
